We need DBE for formula C9H11O0Br. DBE formula: DBE = C - H/2 + N/2 +1 (ignoring halogens: treat halogen as H). For halogen (Br) count as H. So effective H = H + halogen = 11 + 1 =12. No N. So DBE = C - (H_eff)/2 +1 = 9 - 12/2 +1 = 9 -6 +1 =4. So integer 4.

We could retrieve formula via tool but we already know. But to be safe, we can call retrieve_dbe_formula.
